name: Eleven v3
access: ElevenLabs API: Text to Speech and Text to Dialogue (HTTP and stream)

voice.input_audio: none: the model takes text, with optional inline audio tags
voice.output_audio: MP3 (22.05 kHz at 32 kbps, 24 kHz at 48 kbps, 44.1 kHz at 32 to 192 kbps), PCM 8 to 48 kHz 16-bit, WAV 8 to 48 kHz, Opus 48 kHz (32 to 192 kbps), mu-law 8 kHz and A-law 8 kHz; the default is mp3_44100_128; MP3 at 192 kbps needs the Creator plan or above, and PCM or WAV at 44.1 kHz needs Pro or above [el-api-tts]
voice.voices: custom cloning: library voices (the maker's pages give 3,000+, 10,000+ and 5,000+ as counts), instant and professional voice clones, and designed voices [el-tts-overview] [el-voices]
languages: 70+ languages; the models page lists them by ISO 639-3 code [el-models]
voice.turn_detection: none: a synthesis model. The Text to Dialogue WebSocket takes new_turn or a change of voice_id as a turn boundary; the standard Text to Speech WebSocket does not accept this model [el-ws-ttd] [el-ws-tts]
voice.interruption: Not a conversation model: the client stops playback. The docs describe no cancel message for the Text to Dialogue WebSocket [el-ws-ttd]
voice.latency: The docs state no inference latency for eleven_v3; Artificial Analysis reports a median of 31.6 characters generated per second (throughput, not latency) [aa-tts-board]. The maker describes Flash models as faster because they are smaller [el-latency-concept]
voice.session_limit: 5,000 characters per request, about 5 minutes of audio [el-models]; the Text to Dialogue page advises at most 2,000 characters per request [el-ttd-overview]; the Text to Dialogue WebSocket closes after 20 seconds without a client message unless keep_alive is sent [el-ws-ttd]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Per character, not per token. API list price US$0.08 per 1,000 characters [el-pricing-api]. On the website the cost is 1 credit per character; API generations are discounted [el-v3-cost]. Artificial Analysis lists US$100 per 1M characters, which does not match the list price [aa-tts-v3]

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Speech Arena Elo (provider voice leaderboard)
benchmarks.setting: blind pairwise listener votes on ElevenLabs's own voices; the model page gives 1171.45 and the leaderboard table read the same day gives 1173.8

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis text-to-speech median characters per second
benchmarks.setting: median generation speed; read from the leaderboard data on the Artificial Analysis text-to-speech page

unknown: context_window: not applicable to a synthesis model; the limit is in characters, see voice.session_limit
max_output: not published in tokens; the per-request limit is 5,000 characters [el-models]
pricing_usd_per_mtok: the unit differs (US$ per 1,000 characters), see notes
